entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, um, I think I need to return something? It's the VeloBand Pulse monitor. I'm just a bit lost on how to do it.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference matter?

Oh, no, it works fine, I think. To be honest, I just... I guess I **changed my mind**. It was sort of an **impulse buy** around the holidays and I really **don't use it**. The website was a little confusing. I thought I knew what the policy was, but now I'm not sure. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I understand completely. Things can get hectic. Let me just pull up your order details and check the policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 23 days ago.
Is... is that a problem? I'm so sorry, I get so overwhelmed with this stuff.
Not a problem at all. I'm checking our knowledge base now... and yes, you're perfectly fine. All VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's a relief! Thank you.

You're very welcome. I'm processing the return for you right now and I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the item back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow, okay. That's much easier than I thought. Thank you so much for your help, David.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been great.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
